title: 夜明けの灯台と海(曲 + 景色の参照)
description: 音楽タブの曲と、画像タブで作った水彩の灯台を景色の参照に。曲の切れ目で 5 シーン、曲を載せて 30 秒。

values.story: 夜明けの灯台と海。嵐の夜が明け、光が戻ってくる。人物は登場しない。

params.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
静かな夜の帳が降りていく
世界は深い藍色に染まるよ
窓の外には無数の光が瞬く
僕だけの秘密をそっと抱きしめてる

[Pre-Chorus]
風に乗せて届けたい言葉があるんだ
届かなくていいからただ知ってほしいだけ

[Chorus - anthemic]
星降る夜に歌う この想いを叫ぶ
切なくも輝く夢を探してる
遠い空へと届くまで 響かせたいメロディ
君と出会えた奇跡を信じて

[Verse]
冷たい空気の中 微かに震える指先
手のひらには小さな希望が宿るんだ
迷いや不安さえ今は霞んでいくから
ただこの瞬間を永遠に焼き付けたい

[Pre-Chorus]
心の奥底で高鳴る鼓動の音を聞くよ
きっと答えはここにあるはずだから

[Chorus - anthemic]
星降る夜に歌う この想いを叫ぶ
切なくも輝く夢を探してる
遠い空へと届くまで 響かせたいメロディ
君と出会えた奇跡を信じて

[Bridge - gentle]
時が止まってもこの景色は変わらないだろう
静かに願う小さな祈りが巡るように

[Chorus - anthemic]
星降る夜に歌う この想いを叫ぶ (ああ)
切なくも輝く夢を探してる (探してる)
遠い空へと届くまで 響かせたいメロディ
君と出会えた奇跡を信じて

[Outro]
params.caption: A J-POP anthem that blends shimmering melodies with ethereal vocals, capturing the quiet longing beneath a vast night sky.

outline.title: 夜明けの灯台と海 (Dawn Lighthouse and Sea)
outline.setting: A dramatic coastal environment transitioning from a fierce storm to the gentle light of dawn
outline.characters: None. The focus is entirely on the natural elements: the sea, the lighthouse, and the changing light
outline.arc: The narrative moves from intense darkness and chaos (the aftermath of the storm) to serene clarity and hope as the first rays of sunlight break through the clouds, symbolized by the lighthouse beam cutting through the mist
places: {'scene_description': 'A turbulent, dark ocean under a heavy, bruised sky. Waves crash violently against jagged rocks near the base of the lighthouse. The atmosphere is moody and saturated with storm remnants.', 'reference_image': 1}

{'scene_description': 'Close-up on the weathered stone structure of the lighthouse during the height of the residual darkness. Rain has recently stopped, leaving wet sheen on the rocks surrounding it. The light source within is a warm, steady beacon.', 'reference_image': 1}

{'scene_description': "The horizon begins to lighten. A soft, pale grey and gold hue starts to bleed into the heavy clouds over the sea. The ocean's surface begins to calm, the whitecaps softening.", 'reference_image': 1}

{'scene_description': 'A final, breathtaking shot: The lighthouse beam sweeps across a now tranquil, misty expanse of water as the first clear light of dawn fully illuminates the scene. A sense of profound peace settles over the landscape.', 'reference_image': 1}
continuity_rules: The color palette must transition strictly from deep blues/greys (storm) to soft pastels/gold (dawn)
The lighthouse remains a constant, steadfast presence throughout all shots
The sea's movement should gradually decrease in intensity across the sequence
